prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Unity game VFX texture atlas with four equal cells
Primary request: create an original 2-by-2 atlas of energetic liquid-paint effects for a cheerful rhythm paint-shooter. Top-left: compact forward nozzle jet. Top-right: viscous directional stream dash. Bottom-left: loose cluster of rounded airborne droplets. Bottom-right: broad readable surface-impact splash with a few satellite drops.
Style/medium: hand-painted graphic game VFX, chunky wet liquid silhouettes, slightly irregular edges, playful and polished, strong silhouette readability at small size.
Composition/framing: square canvas divided conceptually into four equal cells; one centered effect per cell; generous transparent padding; no cell borders; no effect crosses into another cell.
Color palette: neutral white and very light gray volume only, designed for clean runtime tinting to saturated colors.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background and preserved alpha; no text; no logos; no characters; no weapon; no watermark; entirely original shapes; do not imitate or reproduce assets, iconography, typography, or recognizable designs from Splatoon or any other named game.
